decode.validity: A request update is valid only with a valid request index, nonzero cache location and0<=logical_position<seq_len. Sentinel/invalid positions do not modify the ring.
decode.ring: Logical position p uses pool slot p%4 but physical raw-key/gate slot p%R, where R=4+num_draft_tokens for the speculative preparation domain. These are distinct moduli.
decode.close: Only p%4==3 closes pool floor(p/4). Gather keys and gates for logical[p-3,p], use current input for the final slot, and compute per-channel softmax(gate+APE[slot,channel]) over the four slots, then the weighted key sum.
decode.tail_write: Store current raw key and gate in physical ring slot p%R even when the pool closes. A completed pool does not require zeroing old ring bytes; validity and logical length determine which tail rows remain visible.
decode.official_cache_encoding: The fixed official FP8 reader stores pooled key after BF16 rounding, Hadamard128, another BF16 rounding, then E4 quantization with positive F32 scale, absmax floor1e-4, optional power-of-two scale depending on chosen reader. Index query undergoes its matching rotate_activation path.
decode.encoding_scope: The existing GGUF/F32 mathematical pool fragment does not implement these official FP8 cache byte boundaries. It can be used as an explicit selected GGUF/F32 state consumer; it must not certify official FP8 cache bytes or silently substitute one reader for the other.

extend_and_verify.chunk_formula: For logical start s and consumed length n: first_slot=s%4; base_pool=floor(s/4); closed=floor((s+n)/4)-base_pool; consumed_into_pools=max(0,closed*4-first_slot); remaining_tail=n-consumed_into_pools. A first newly closed pool may combine the old partial tail with the new Graph-produced chunk.
extend_and_verify.tail_source: The plan explicitly carries n_from_tail, tail_logical_base and chunk_src. Remaining raw keys/gates write from chunk_src into physical slots(dst_logical_start+i)%R.
extend_and_verify.per_query_visibility: For candidate k, visible seq_len=s+k+1 and visible completed-pool count=floor((s+k+1)/4). A candidate must not attend a completed pool containing its future siblings.
extend_and_verify.effective_n: The verify/v2 ring writer may store its fixed N candidate rows in the extra ring slots, but closure count uses effective_n_per_batch when supplied. Thus logical validity/accepted count remains essential even if rejected bytes are physically present.
extend_and_verify.old_fallback_limit: The non-plan extend fallback rejects nonaligned first_slot!=0; this is not a mathematical requirement to forbid partial-prefix continuation in Hyle. The fixed plan path explicitly combines old tail with a new chunk.
extend_and_verify.hyle_publication: A Hyle implementation can retain immutable whole candidate versions instead of imitating SGLang in-place rollback. Selecting a prefix must select the matching MLA, pool, ring, hidden, IDs and counters together; merely decreasing seq_len on the final full candidate bank is insufficient.

tail_ids.rules: Top512 completed pool IDs expand to their four logical token IDs. Always append seq_len%4 unpooled tail tokens starting at4*pool_len, with at most3 padded slots. Unused slots are-1. Page-table translation or explicit topk offset belongs to the selected cache coordinate system.
tail_ids.gather_safety: Strip or qualify the padded-1 tail positions with actual visible length before checked Gather; never map-1 to row0 or select more than the prefix-visible rows.

same_epoch_index_reuse.important_skip_fact: For NextN with prev_topk_indices present, should_run_indexer is false. The whole indexer is skipped, not merely TopK. MLA and hidden may advance while raw index keys/gates/completed pools retain their old leases.
same_epoch_index_reuse.cursor_separation: Track MLA consumed cursor and indexer-produced-through cursor separately, plus seed producer/epoch/selection coordinate extent. Never fabricate indexer writes or advance its cursor merely to keep it equal to MLA length during skip.

important_facts: With an actual previous top-k seed, NextN skips the entire indexer, not only TopK. Its MLA cursor may advance while indexer cursor/raw ring/pool bank remain unchanged.

mHC streams are per-token residual data flowing across target layers, not an additional temporal recurrent cache. A next target token starts from its actual new-token layer input, not the previous token's final mHC streams.
hc_contract is the mean over the hc_mult dimension. Its exact placement and normalization depend on the target output/tap boundary; do not substitute a convenient arbitrary norm for the NextN seed.

When accepting a prefix, select its journal range together with latent cache, hidden, q-residual, pending token, raw ring/pools and split cursors in one StateDraft/StateHead publication. Rejected candidate features never enter the accepted journal.

At iteration end disable old reuse. A small ordinary catchup Graph consumes only accepted journal ReadLeases and the old raw-ring/pool state.
